what: Verbatim copies of the shared Anthropic credit pool policy files. The sibling runtime's repository owns them; this repository copies them so the pool module and its tests can run on their own. Never edit a copy here: change the original, pass its vectors there, then refresh both copies and these ids together.
check_against_the_source: Set ZAKCODE_POOL_SOURCE_CHECKOUT to a checkout of the source repository and run tests/test_anthropic_pool_vectors.py: the drift test compares the source files' blob ids with the ones above.
